content.body:
If you've got that urgent diarrhea that hits with zero warning, you need to see this because that's bacterial overgrowth.

Urgent diarrhea, painful bloating, and that constant feeling like your gut is on a hair trigger are all signs of bacterial overgrowth in your small intestine and is something I'm constantly seeing get overlooked in clients.

As a gut health researcher, I'm very passionate about digestive health education and I believe helping people understand what's actually happening in their body is extremely important.

So in simple terms, an overgrowth of bad bacteria in your small intestine creates something called biofilms.

And these are basically protective shields that the hydrogen-producing bacteria build around themselves to survive, which research shows are responsible for the majority of chronic gut issues.

And although it's not really talked about, it's the very reason anti-diarrheals or dietary changes don't fix the problem long term because the bacteria underneath survives and regrows again.

But what's most important to understand is that as women age and go through hormonal changes like menopause, gut motility slows, creating ideal conditions for bad bacteria to rapidly overgrow.

So motility down, bad bacteria up, biofilms up.

And a lot of my clients are being told they need probiotics, a low-FODMAP diet, or even antibiotics, but this is just covering the symptoms and not addressing the root cause.

So what we have to do is target the overgrowth directly first so the gut can actually heal.

And the only natural compound shown to disrupt these bacterial biofilms is not antibiotics or capsule supplements, but it's actually a potent antimicrobial from oregano called carvacrol.

And new research shows it disrupts up to 98% of biofilm structure, enough to create lasting, healthy balance when delivered in the right form.

But most gut supplements or oregano capsules have oregano flavoring or oregano powder, but none of them actually deliver concentrated carvacrol.

So they never break through the biofilm, they only agitate it to grow thicker.

And the huge mistake I see many clients make is they don't target the overgrowth first and instead just take probiotics or capsules.

And not only does this make the overgrowth harder to address, but capsules can't absorb through a damaged gut lining, meaning the bacteria never gets targeted, starting a cycle of relapse, which is where the bad bacteria keep fermenting food prematurely in the small intestine, and is why people who take supplements for a long time feel like the diarrhea and bloating just doesn't go away or even gets worse.

So we not only need real carvacrol extract, but it needs to be in liquid form, as not all delivery methods are created equal.

But taking it as liquid drops ensures it bypasses the damaged gut lining entirely and makes direct contact with the overgrowth to restore normal digestion.

Now we typically see symptoms improving within the first few weeks as the overgrowth reduces and the bacterial environment rebalances.

And the brand we recommend is Nutrition Therapy because they're the only over-the-counter formula on the market using real carvacrol in a liquid drop format that your gut can actually absorb.

So if that chronic diarrhea and bloating started out of nowhere, this is why.

Grab Nutrition Therapy's Oil of Oregano drops today and they're even including a free gift worth $32 with your order.
